scientific_integrity: The analytic proof, not finite tests, supports the universal minimax and almost-sure claims. Historical expectation-versus-typical convergence theory is credited. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Requires diagonal positive potential and interaction matrices, exact Wasserstein gradient pushforwards, fixed iid full-support sampling and scalar steps.
Does not claim finite-time almost-sure tail bounds, adaptive-policy optimality, non-diagonal or nonlinear extensions, or computational runtime advantages.
Full historical randomized Kaczmarz text was inaccessible; conceptual and reduction-based originality risk remains.
scientific_scope: Sharp expected-energy and almost-sure exponential-rate minimax over fixed iid coordinate samplers and positive stable steps for diagonal strictly positive quadratic potential-and-interaction Wasserstein energies, arbitrary finite-second-moment initial laws.
title: Annealed and almost-sure optimal sampling diverge for interacting Wasserstein coordinate descent
